value.message: The comparison helps you to evaluate access controls for the selected users for a resource. You can also select record and field level inputs to narrow down the access issue. Access Analyzer runs on both the users and the results side by side.
The access control comparison page displays the evaluation states for different ACL operations.

When comparing access controls between the users, following are the different evaluation states: 

  • Passed
  • Blocked
  • Skipped
When you enable the Show differences only checkbox, only the operation evaluation state that is different between the user 1 and user 2 is displayed.
